notes: Only real controller methods with tests are registered. V3 adds six existing privacy/conversation operations; the full R1 design remains 57 operations. DB-dependent routes require KTOB_DB_ENABLED=true and verified JWT. Groq dispatch additionally requires a server-only key, confirmed provider qualification and current reader consent. This registry describes source implementation, not production deployment; see v3-release-demo.md and the historical V2 record.
